name: Dynamic Leg Swing with Support

instructions.description: Stand beside a stable chair, a wall or other stable support and hold it with one hand for support. Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your core gently engaged.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg and swing the opposite leg gently forward and backward through a comfortable range of motion.
Keep your upper body upright and your pelvis stable. Let the movement come from the hip while keeping the swinging leg relaxed.
Gradually slow the movement, place the foot back on the floor, and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Dynamic Leg Swing with Support — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use a stable support that will not move or tip.
Keep your trunk upright and avoid leaning forward or backward.
Start with a small range of motion and gradually increase it if comfortable.
Keep the supporting knee slightly soft rather than locked.
